title: Create blue star anime themed OTT platform logo

requirements.text: Generate a logo for an OTT (over-the-top) streaming platform featuring a star design with anime-style aesthetics in blue color scheme

quotes: star anime blue colour ott logon logo

acceptanceCriteria: Logo features a prominent star element
Logo is suitable for an OTT/streaming platform brand
Image is generated and stored in frontend/public/assets/generated

requirements.text: Display the generated OTT logo prominently in the application interface
acceptanceCriteria: Logo is rendered as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated
Logo is visible and properly sized in the UI
Logo maintains quality and clarity at display size

requirements.text: Implement a creative visual theme with cohesive colors, typography, and layout that complements the anime-style blue star logo aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: Visual design theme is consistent across all UI components
Color scheme harmonizes with the blue star logo
Typography choices support the anime/streaming platform aesthetic
Layout and interaction patterns feel cohesive with the overall design direction

nonGoals: Creating multiple logo variations or animated versions

required: Blue star-shaped logo with anime aesthetic for OTT streaming platform, vibrant blue gradients, dynamic star design with sharp points, modern and eye-catching style suitable for digital branding (ott-logo.dim_512x512.png)
